sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A shrubby succulent euphorbia endemic to Abd al Kuri Island in the Socotra Archipelago. Clumps are often about 1 m tall and 1.5 m wide; larger individuals are reported.

sections.title: Stems and flowers
sections.text: The thick, greyish, branched stems bear small inflorescences characteristic of euphorbias, called cyathia.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: The yellow latex is reported as toxic by the horticultural sources consulted. Avoid contact with eyes or mouth; no part should be eaten.
